It also omits raw message IDs beyond the two cited record references, email addresses, account details, and retrieval links.

- The inventory is grounded in the canonical inbox export only; no attachment contents, calendar database, or message-body validation beyond the recorded snippets was inspected.
- The Project Sync entry records an accepted invitation, but the inbox export alone does not prove attendance.
- The Q3 Budget Review entry records a requested review/confirmation, but does not prove that Alice completed it.
- No deduplication or cross-source completion check was performed.
